title: Broadband Access
subtitle: Home internet availability in Burton: FCC National Broadband Map (2025-12-31)

charts.title: Where each provider reaches (% of Burton homes)

source: FCC National Broadband Map (Broadband Data Collection), fixed residential availability, Burton city, as of 2025-12-31.

links.text: Look up your address on the FCC National Broadband Map

notes: Availability = where service can be ordered (reported by providers), not actual speeds or price, the FCC collects no pricing data.
"Broadband" is the FCC benchmark of 100/20 Mbps. Speed figures are the share of broadband-serviceable homes with reported access at each speed.
Satellite (HughesNet (EchoStar), Viasat, Starlink (SpaceX)) reaches all of Burton, so it is counted but not charted with the wired/wireless providers most homes actually choose between.
"Households with broadband" is actual subscriptions (US Census ACS 2023), a different measure than availability. Not endorsed by the Census Bureau.
Source: FCC National Broadband Map. This product is not endorsed or certified by the FCC.
